data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 0.8 million in 2021, representing 0.10% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This net deterioration is explicitly stated as affecting claims reserves established at the prior year end. Despite an overall net strengthening, the syndicate reported a favourable net movement of GBP 1.3 million related to COVID-19 losses from the 2020 year, indicating a mixed development across prior years. The gross claims development triangle is considered unreliable for calculating prior year development due to significant RITC adjustments during the year.

Historic development includes a mix of prior year releases and deteriorations, and in 2021 gross and net deteriorations occurred.
deterioration of GBP 0.8m pre LPT (2020: deterioration of GBP 7.9m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported net of reinsurance due to RITC distortion making the gross claims development triangle unreliable. The reported figure is a net deterioration.
